title: Governed Cloudinary delivery pilot
intent: Improve responsive image delivery for two authorized public derivatives without moving governance, originals, social cards, documents, fonts, or private archive material out of the repository boundary.

criteria.criterion: Exactly two repository derivatives are bound to exact versioned Cloudinary assets with matching dimensions and SHA-256 receipts.
Cloudinary URLs cap width at the source, negotiate format and quality, and expose only the reviewed responsive width sets.
The social preview, resume PDF, fonts, unlisted images, originals, and private archive stay same-origin; local public assets remain packaged for rollback.
The homepage hero is preloaded, pilot evidence images are lazy below the fold, and artifact galleries do not force eager loading.
The pilot defaults off and a missing or invalid Cloudinary configuration falls back to the same-origin repository asset.
The upload authorization is recorded as destination-bound, production remains Jamie-authorized, and no Cloudinary API secret is present in public code or receipts.
